About This Auction

PROPERTY: Residence, Detached Garage, and Shop in Sedgwick, Kansas near Valley Center AUCTION DATE: September 10th, 2025 at 6 PM Central OPEN HOUSE: Sunday September 7th, 2025 2 PM - 4 PM Central   How long have you been looking for this exact property? Nice house, big shop, plenty of space… this checks all the boxes! L2 Realty, Inc. is proud to present this auction opportunity for a beautifully updated home with that rural lifestyle feel, all set on 5.5 acres in the Valley Center School District. This 4-bedroom, 3-bath residence offers nearly 2,600 sq ft of living space, a finished basement with a safe room/storm shelter, a detached garage, and a huge shop! Kitchen and Living Room: When you step through the front door you will notice an inviting open-concept layout where the kitchen, dining, and living areas flow seamlessly together. The whole space has been updated in recent years, creating a bright and functional hub for family gatherings and entertaining. The kitchen has plenty of cabinet space and an island for additional cooking prep and storage. A gas fireplace creates a nice focal point in the living room and adds warmth on those chilly winter evenings. Bedrooms: The main level also features generously sized bedrooms, including a master bedroom, guest or kids room, and a small office or nursery. Two bathrooms can be found on the main level. The master bath adjoins its bedroom along with a walk-in closet. The second bathroom has easy access from the main hallway, perfect for kids and guests. If you venture downstairs, a fourth bedroom and bathroom can be found. Basement: The fully finished basement adds even more living space with a large family room and fireplace, a wet bar, a concrete safe room for peace of mind during storms, and plenty of storage. A separate room houses all the utilities and laundry, keeping them tucked away from the exposed areas. The living area and bar could be turned into the ultimate spot to watch the big game and entertain your friends! Porch and Pool: Walking out the back door, you will find yourself on the covered porch overlooking a pool and the rest of the property. What a great spot to fire up the grill and enjoy a cold beer! When summer hits, relax by the pool and take a dip to cool off. This natural pool-inspired swimming hole is a great addition to the outdoor spaces. <
